summary: SSE helper performing a weighted interpolation across three input points: loads a2 as the base, then computes base + (a3 - base)*a5 + (a4 - base)*a6, stores the packed result into output a1, and returns a1.

operations.description: Load packed a2 into SSE register v6 (upper lanes) as the base.
Compute (a3 - v6) and scale by a5 via SSE sub, mul and shuffle-0 broadcast.
Compute (a4 - v6) and scale by a6 via SSE sub, mul and shuffle-0 broadcast.
Add both scaled deltas to base v6 to produce the interpolated result.
Store the packed result into output a1 via SSE store-high.

clean_pseudocode: result = v6 + (a3 - v6) * a5 + (a4 - v6) * a6;
